scope.deduplication_rule: Occurrences sharing one selection rule, estimand, and decision consequence are one finding; repeated prose and table cells are retained as exact locations.
scope.command_hash_rule: For command=python -, command_sha256 is SHA-256 of ASCII stdin_source_lines joined by LF with one final LF; otherwise it is SHA-256 of the literal command string.
scope.result_hash_rule: For stdin probes, result_sha256 is SHA-256 of ASCII stdout after CRLF-to-LF normalization and removal of trailing line terminators. Human-readable result is a summary, not the hashed payload. For the ZFIELD checker, result_hashes bind the input checker and its two result artifacts.
scope.prohibited_work: No new stack was rendered. Read-only source and already-produced artifacts were used.

headline: No current SOTA scorecard PASS becomes FAIL: the board remains unmeasured. M95 B1 remains a valid conditional PASS while full-candidate fidelity is UNMEASURED; the formal M-COVER geometry clauses are also UNMEASURED. M116's first-100/global-frame reversal is already documented, not a currently wrong board verdict. M109's causal bar is the live categorical downgrade; ZFIELD and V-ORACLE remain unresolved.

scorecard_and_proposal_gates.reason: The scorecard states 0 measured / 12 unmeasured and forbids importing these pre-existing results as score outputs.

scorecard_and_proposal_gates.gate: M-COVER common-overlap FOV and clean-site clauses
scorecard_and_proposal_gates.reason: The live scorecard names common-input overlap once but does not construct its scene-coordinate population. Array containment is only a diagnostic surrogate.
The 81.905756% PASS is conditional on pixels reachable through 23 rendered candidates; 276 of 299 candidates are absent.
The favorable P9 headline and halo exception were already withdrawn. Full-299 evidence strengthens KEEP-OFF rather than reversing it.
First-64 timing cannot populate M11, which remains scientifically blocked and unmeasured.
The 30,000-draw result was SURVIVE, NOT ROBUST and explicitly did not license A5.

findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: Field macro has a very high failure rate and alignment fragility is important.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Attempt count, failed-attempt count, inclusion period, capture definition, and sampling rule.
findings.gate_effect: Do not use as a product, corpus, or field-wide rate.
findings.replacement_text: One experienced practitioner qualitatively reported a high failure rate in field macro; no attempt count or sampling rule was given, so this is context for fragility, not a quantitative rate.

findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: 122/122 decoded; the hard dependency was cleared and an in-house decoder branch stayed closed.
findings.true_population: Every camera RAW mode and file class the product promises to accept.
findings.population_basis: Established by the product support claim, not by the 122-file convenience corpus.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: A frozen acceptance corpus spanning every supported capture mode, or an explicit support-scope restriction to the tested modes.
findings.gate_effect: Keep the dependency decision, but do not claim universal A7C II support.
findings.replacement_text: The external decoder passed 122/122 files in two bounded corpora. That supports retaining the dependency for the tested modes; support outside that acceptance pool remains UNMEASURED.

denominator_chain: all pixels in the fixed crop
multi-peak enrichment at an independently scaled depth-step map
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: 4.38x enrichment supported the review's occlusion/two-depth bimodality mechanism.
findings.true_population: All pixels in the fixed crop over all 105 frames for the numeric M21 rate; independently, the population of candidate occlusion cells for the two-depth interpretation.
findings.population_basis: The capture size is stated in M21; M63 later tested the interpretation on real cells and truth-known plants.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: The full-105 M21 rate remains uncomputed, but no such rerun can rescue the two-depth interpretation refuted by M63.
findings.flip_context: HISTORICAL_REVERSAL_ALREADY_DOCUMENTED; not caused solely by the frame cap
findings.gate_effect: Reject promotion of bimodality as an occlusion detector; retain only the scoped observation that multi-peaked curves occur.
findings.replacement_text: On a 21-of-105 frame subsample, multi-peaked curves were enriched 4.38x at the chosen depth-step map. Later M63 evidence shows that this bimodality is dominated by a single-depth defocus side-lobe and does not identify occlusion or a second depth.

denominator_chain: top intensity-gradient decile versus lower strata
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: The 0.0% top-decile versus 9.2% comparison rejected intensity-edge confounding.
findings.true_population: The fixed crop over all 105 frames under the same intensity-decile rule.
findings.population_basis: Capture size and decimation are stated in M21.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Full-density stratified rates; however, M63 already shows the relative-range statistic is blind at edges.
findings.gate_effect: Do not use this stratum as reassurance for the occlusion detector.
findings.replacement_text: The 21-frame intensity stratum returned 0.0% at the strongest edges, but later analysis identifies that result as evidence of edge blindness in the self-normalized detector, not evidence that edge confounding was excluded.

findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: The permutation comparison established detector headroom on the coarse sampled ladder.
findings.true_population: Real and placebo curves over all 105 frames under a valid noise-calibrated null.
findings.population_basis: The source capture has 105 frames; M63 re-ran the placebo logic at calibrated thresholds.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: No full-105 rerun of M21's original statistic, but the original placebo is already invalid for interpreting two-depth prevalence.
findings.gate_effect: Reject the 18x value as detector headroom.
findings.replacement_text: The 18.0x real/placebo contrast was measured on 21 of 105 frames. M63 later showed the same permutation placebo can fire more often than real data and cannot calibrate a noise-based bimodality test, so it is not detector headroom.

findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: Two observed points refute a fixed bracket-length fraction.

findings.gate_effect: Keep photometric off by default; remove the no-harm rationale.
findings.replacement_text: The main-campaign 'photometric never harms' claim is superseded: its decisive bee arm used the first 100 of 299 frames, while the all-299 campaign reports harm on 10 of 12 windows. No promotion remains the correct decision; the no-harm supporting claim does not.

findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: P9: the merge is sharper than the sharpest single source frame on all three subjects.
findings.true_population: For each scored site, the best source among every frame in that subject's full bracket.
findings.population_basis: AST/text probe verified LIMIT=100 and sorted-prefix selection; the source documents a per-site control changing 1.1458 to 0.8110.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Full-bracket per-site ceilings for M116's three original subjects if their exact ratios are wanted; the P9 direction is already invalidated by the independent control.
findings.flip_context: HISTORICAL_REVERSAL_ALREADY_DOCUMENTED; not a currently wrong board verdict
findings.gate_effect: Do not close M85 or use P9 as a merge-quality PASS.
findings.replacement_text: P9 is not established. Its 'sharpest frame' was one global frame selected from a first-100 prefix; bee's omitted 199 focus positions and the global reference both weaken the ceiling. An independent per-site ceiling changes 1.1458 (merge sharper) to 0.8110 (merge softer), so M85 remains open.

denominator_chain: paired and unpaired photometric statistics plus trap
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: On bee, photometric harms under three designs; the unpaired headline and paired statistic disagree; the violation-count channel fails its trap.
findings.true_population: All eligible project subjects and preregistered windows for any corpus-wide promotion statement.
findings.population_basis: All 299 frames are complete internally; the report identifies one subject and 12 windows.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Repeat the frozen paired statistic and trap across the remaining eligible subjects.
findings.gate_effect: KEEP OFF remains conservative; do not call one-subject harm universal.
findings.replacement_text: Campaign 6 uses all 299 bee frames and supports KEEP OFF on that subject: paired q reports harm and the violation-count channel fails its trap. It is one selected subject and 12 windows, not a corpus-wide effect rate.

denominator_chain: one selected background ROI and bounded window pools
patchwork mechanism, photometric sign, and local defect rates
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: The shipped merge manufactures patchwork in a featureless ROI; gate 4 mostly fixes mosaic but leaves a silhouette-local residual; photometric harm is localized to structured windows.
findings.true_population: All eligible subjects and independently frozen ROIs/windows for prevalence or default-setting claims; the one ROI itself is complete over all 299 frames.
findings.population_basis: The source uses all 299 frames and explicitly limits Parts IV/V to one stack and selected regions.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Repeat the commissioned statistics across independently selected subjects, ROIs, and spatial scales; native single-frame renders are needed for some general comparisons.
findings.gate_effect: Retain existence of a shipped-path defect and KEEP-OFF for harmful photometric behavior; do not promote one-stack percentages as corpus rates.
findings.replacement_text: M120 proves existence on one complete 299-frame stack and one fully evaluated featureless ROI: the shipped output exceeds the constant-convex-weight bound there. Its window fractions, photometric sign, and defect prevalence remain one-stack/selected-region results and must not be quoted as corpus-wide.

denominator_chain: pixels resolved by at most one retained sample
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: At 53 frames only 0.01% are resolved by at most one sample; the bracket is saturated and a half-step pass should be diagnostic, not default.
findings.true_population: Genuinely under-sampled real captures across eligible subjects for a real-practice prevalence claim.
findings.population_basis: The measured population is a deliberate decimation of one convenience-selected complete stack, not an independently acquired coarse bracket.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: A genuinely under-sampled real acquisition and a non-oracle reliability filter across subjects.
findings.gate_effect: Keep the diagnostic-only recommendation; do not claim real under-sampled capture prevalence.
findings.replacement_text: On one coffee-bean crop deliberately decimated from 105 to 53 frames, 0.01% of reliable pixels were resolved by at most one sample. This validates the within-stack diagnostic direction, not performance on genuinely under-sampled field captures.

denominator_chain: all pixels in stated read-noise and gathered-frame clipping cells
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: Read noise affects 0.0000% and gathered-frame clipping is at most 0.075%; support HDR co-bracketing but do not default it.
findings.true_population: Eligible scene classes and noise/dynamic-range regimes, especially specular flash subjects.
findings.population_basis: The report is complete within three stacks but explicitly identifies unmeasured regimes.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Broader fixed-budget captures including read-noise-limited and specular/high-dynamic-range scenes.
findings.gate_effect: The conservative support-not-default decision stands; never trigger from a presumed 0.0000% outside the measured stacks.
findings.replacement_text: Across the three measured stacks, no pixel was read-noise-limited under the registered rule and gathered-frame clipping was at most 0.075%. This supports a per-stack trigger and no default; demand in unmeasured specular or read-noise regimes remains UNMEASURED.

findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: The sample reported 2.75274% mean and 48.6897% exact; the discrepancy with M34 was investigated.
findings.true_population: All 1,048,576 fixture pixels.
findings.population_basis: M36 reports the complete-population row and retained JSON: 2.75314% mean without baseline and 48.9214% exact.
findings.gate_effect: No headline decision changes; retain the 0.23 pp population correction.
findings.replacement_text: The 40,000-pixel cap is resolved by M36's all-1,048,576-pixel rerun. The exact-hit fraction moves from 48.6897% to about 48.91%-48.92% and the substantive verdict does not change.

denominator_chain: complete arm grids within those ROIs
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: R3 remains refuted; one FRC limb was withdrawn as right-censored, while noise and hull failures survive.
findings.true_population: All eligible aligned stacks and an admitted real-detail population for corpus-wide magnitude claims.
findings.population_basis: The source explicitly limits itself to two stacks, one ROI each, and the then-unaligned shipped path.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Aligned/iterative arms and admitted real-detail regions across the corpus for prevalence; no new data are needed to retain the observed counterexamples.
findings.gate_effect: Keep R3 rejected on the measured failure modes; do not quote 64%-81% as a corpus rate.
findings.replacement_text: M41's 64%-81% hull and noise failures are two-stack, one-ROI observations, not corpus rates. The FRC ratio limb is withdrawn as censored; the independent observed failures and later deconvolution evidence still support rejecting R3.

denominator_chain: one selected subject per aperture and five selected ROIs
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: Scoped B=5 falsification and diffraction findings support a shooting recommendation; several wider-aperture knees are only bounds.
findings.true_population: Independent subjects, sessions, and apertures for the reference lens/body setup.
findings.population_basis: The source is exhaustive within selected captures but has one subject/session per aperture and labels f/8 and f/5.6 knees unmeasurable.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Independent sessions and subjects, including a primary fixed-subject aperture ladder and a clean f/5.6 measurement.
findings.gate_effect: Retain scoped optical constraints; do not state the bandwidth-cost figures as rig-wide population values.
findings.replacement_text: M5's cases are complete within selected captures and support the scoped diffraction falsification. Numeric bandwidth costs and shooting advice remain one-session/one-subject-per-aperture results; f/8 and f/5.6 provide bounds, not measured knees.

denominator_chain: pixels whose product winner is uniquely one of those candidates
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: B1 PASS at 81.9058% on the preregistered testable-pixel subset; the source says the residual bounds downstream conclusions.
findings.true_population: All 299 candidate frames and all eligible pixels in the registered ROIs.
findings.population_basis: The artifact census verifies 23 candidates, 276 missing, and only 24.85%-28.74% detail-ROI coverage; the PASS is conditional on that selected reachable subset.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Render the missing 276 single frames, recover the full 299-way product truth, run the model over all 299 candidates, and score every eligible pixel under the same ambiguity rule.
findings.gate_effect: Do not promote downstream M95 election-offset conclusions through B1 as a full-population PASS. The preregistered conditional 23-way diagnostic remains valid.
findings.replacement_text: B1 is a CONDITIONAL PASS as registered: 81.905756% agreement among testable pixels whose 299-way product winner is uniquely reachable through 23 rendered candidates, covering 24.85%-28.74% of the detail ROIs. With 276 candidates absent, full-299 model fidelity remains UNMEASURED.

denominator_chain: destroyed-signal lower bounds and binned-resolution indictment
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: The binned path destroys 10.7%-29.2% of top-octave green signal on four crops; real signal exists above binned Nyquist.
findings.true_population: All eligible subjects and the complete resolvable green band for any corpus-wide magnitude.
findings.population_basis: The source repeatedly states one bee subject and fixed tiles; a single positive subject can establish existence but not prevalence.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Repeat on independent eligible subjects and measure the unseen higher band with an admitted instrument.
findings.gate_effect: Retain the existence/lower-bound result for bee; do not publish a corpus-wide destroyed-detail rate.
findings.replacement_text: On one bee-3-cpl capture and four blind crops, the binned path destroys at least 10.7%-29.2% of the measured top-octave green signal. This is a valid single-subject counterexample and lower bound, not a corpus-wide loss rate.

denominator_chain: global per-pixel candidate estimators without focus selection
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: Every candidate destroys 64%-82% of subject gradient energy and must be gated to background.
findings.true_population: Every frame and eligible subject region for an all-frame magnitude; one counterexample is enough to bar unconditionally applying a background estimator to detail.
findings.population_basis: The source explicitly identifies the no-focus-selection confound and uses the result as a risk bound.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Full-stack focused candidates for exact loss magnitudes; none is needed for the conservative background-only restriction.
findings.gate_effect: Keep the background-only restriction; do not quote 64%-82% as production loss.
findings.replacement_text: Nine-frame, no-focus-selection candidates lose 64%-82% of subject gradient energy in this probe. The number is not a production estimate; it is a conservative demonstration that any such envelope must be restricted to background pixels.

denominator_chain: six tiles per probe at one scale
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: Patchwork 1.305 falls to 0.165 at gate 4.5 with detail unchanged; raise the default after a gallery.
findings.true_population: All frames, independently registered tiles, scales, and eligible subjects for a default-setting recommendation.
findings.population_basis: The source states 8/299, six tiles, one scale, and explicitly requires a gallery and independent replication.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Full-299, multi-subject, multi-scale rerun with independent verification and a ladder extending until the detail control moves.
findings.gate_effect: Do not change a default from this arm alone; it licenses the gallery.
findings.replacement_text: On one subject, 8 of 299 frames, six tiles, and one scale, gate 4.5 strongly reduces the patchwork probe without moving its detail controls. This is a next-gallery result, not a default-setting PASS.

findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: Median 2.756x and 126/128 master wins imply reconstruction beyond any source frame.
findings.true_population: All source frames and independently frozen, non-outcome-selected sites across eligible subjects.
findings.population_basis: The source states 30/299 and master-selected sites; section 105 later removes the frame cap for nine subjects but not the outer subject/site selection population.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: No full-frame rerun is needed for the nine later subjects; independently selected sites and the remaining 17 subjects are still missing for a corpus claim.
findings.gate_effect: Use the later full-stack evidence, not 126/128, and keep the corpus-wide reconstruction conclusion caveated.
findings.replacement_text: The 2.756x and 126/128 figures use 30 of 299 frames and two sites selected for detail in the master. Later full-stack results on nine subjects support that the effect is not unique to bee-1, but the original win rate remains outcome-selection-biased and is not a corpus rate.

findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: Every one of nine subjects is above 1.0; bee-1 alone did not create the result.
findings.true_population: All 26 SHIP-V3 subjects under the same metric and a pre-frozen site rule.
findings.population_basis: The source states nine of 26 and full stacks.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: The remaining 17 subjects under the unchanged metric/site rule.
findings.gate_effect: May reject 'bee-1 only'; may not promote 'all corpus subjects reconstruct.'
findings.replacement_text: Full-stack measurements on nine selected subjects all exceed 1.0, so the effect is not unique to bee-1. Seventeen of 26 subjects remain unmeasured, so a corpus-wide universal or prevalence claim is UNMEASURED.

denominator_chain: decision rule based on bias direction
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: Subsampling biases the minimum high and the ratio down: positive convictions are conservative floors; acquittals can flip.
findings.true_population: Every source frame in each claimed stack.
findings.population_basis: The order-statistic direction is derived exactly and checked on one complete stack.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Full-stack minima for each subsampled subject before issuing an acquittal or exact magnitude.
findings.gate_effect: Positive excess may be retained as a floor; non-excess cannot acquit.
findings.replacement_text: When the source minimum is taken over a frame subsample, the denominator is biased high and master/min(source) is biased low. Positive excess is therefore a conservative floor; an acquittal remains UNMEASURED until the full-stack minimum is used.

denominator_chain: about 60-100 strided frames per measured stack
findings.original_conclusion_or_verdict: A universal 0.25 boundary and several texture/defocus predictors are rejected; observed subject range and band-qualification rates are reported.
findings.true_population: All 34 roster subjects and every frame in each stack for corpus ranges or qualification rates.
findings.population_basis: The report records 11 convenience-selected subjects and computational frame subsampling.
findings.missing_data_or_compute: Measure the remaining 23 roster subjects and full frame populations under the same band and eligibility rules.
findings.gate_effect: Keep rejection of a universal 0.25 boundary and rejection of the aggressive setting on measured counterexamples; do not call 0.17-0.48 a corpus range or 5/11 a corpus rate.
findings.replacement_text: Across 11 convenience-selected, frame-subsampled subjects, the observed boundary varies enough to refute a universal 0.25 value and the measured counterexamples reject the aggressive setting. The 0.17-0.48 span and 5-of-11 qualification rate are not 34-subject corpus estimates.
